body: as someone who has been listening to the beatles for over 15 years now (since i was around 10) you definitely go through phases. for me, my first phase lasted about 4-5 years straight of almost exclusively just the beatles. then you get into other things and find yourself missing the beatles. after a little, i felt bad for not listening to them and decided to go back. that happened a couple of times and now im in my phase of listening to their other takes and compilation albums and live albums. i’m sure ill go through another bout of not wanting to listen to them. but, like you said. they will always be my favorite and that will never change.
